variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, wants the wolves that take his sheep killed.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
I was walking my sheep along the edge of the Ashwood when a pack of wolves came out of the trees. Halvard sent me out here to mind the town's flock and keep watch on the wood.

Please, if you can drive those wolves off for good, I'll be sure to help you in return.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Hurry, kind sir! I don't have many sheep left to lose!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Yay! The wolves are gone and my sheep are safe in the fold again! Here, take my bow, it's yours.

journal.text: Go into the Ashwood and kill the wolves raiding Ulric's flock.

variants.specifics: Kal Vorra: Pellam the mule keeper wants the Spiders of the west tunnel cleared out after they ate his best mule.

offer.speaker: Pellam
offer.text:
Spiders? Sure, I know all about 'em. Ate my best mule.

Follow the west tunnel, out past the ore carts, over the rope bridge. That's where they nest. Clear 'em out and there's gold in it for you.

reminder.speaker: Pellam
reminder.text: I am glad to see a brave stranger take up the fight which can rid Kal Vorra of those Spiders.

completion.speaker: Pellam
completion.text: Thanks for your help! Here's 100 gold. Now I just have to go buy myself a new mule!

journal.text: Clear the Spiders out of the west tunnel for Pellam the mule keeper.

variants.specifics: Velk: Hobb, a goatherd on the edge of the Black Fen, wants the giant Leech called the Bog Mother killed.

offer.speaker: Hobb
offer.text: The Bog Mother is a monstrous creature. It grows fat on warm blood, which it sucks from my goats in the darkest pools of the Black Fen. Kill it, and I'll pay you well.

reminder.speaker: Hobb
reminder.text: One of the little Leeches -- with a terrible bite -- got up into my boat last night. Maybe the Bog Mother is sending them after me!

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: Thanks for ridding the fen of that beast. Here, take this Bow.

journal.text: Find the Bog Mother and slay her in The Black Fen.

variants.specifics: Castle Tarbek: Fennick, Master of Hounds, wants the Black Bears of the Thornwood driven off his hounds.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Hello, I am Fennick, the Master of Hounds for Castle Tarbek.

What might a traveler be doing so far from the high road? Hmm, let me guess... Ostrik has sent you to help Commander Brask with some garrison business.

Well, I've no great love for Brask and his endless marching drills, but let me put you to better use, stranger.

The Black Bears of the Thornwood, west of the castle, keep killing my hounds. Drive them off and I'll see you rewarded. Take this bow. It might help when they charge.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: They got another! They got another! Um... You'd best hurry.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
Marvelous! Tarbek owes you a debt it can never repay.

But no time to fuss over my poor hounds now! Morvane's dead men are stirring! Take this quiver and go after them, if you want to see an end to his wicked doings!

journal.text: Battle your way through the Thornwood and drive off the Black Bears for Fennick.

variants.specifics: Kelm: Mott, an old fisherman, pays a bounty on the Bears from the pine woods that raid his smokehouse.

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text:
I'm the one paying the bounty on Bears this season. The brutes have raided my smokehouse 3 nights out of 4. You have to clear out their whole den to collect.

Every hunter gets a Bow from me. This one is yours. Carry it up to their den in the pine woods when you're ready.

reminder.speaker: Mott
reminder.text: Those Bears are the boldest and greediest thieves on all of Lake Kelm. Your trip to their den will show whether you're fit to carry that Bow of mine.

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Thanks again Wanderer. You have done the whole shore a great service, one I won't soon forget. Here's your bounty.

journal.text: Clear the Bears out of their den in the pine woods.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Fennick the groundskeeper, his leg broken, wants the Wisps driven out of the cistern under the orchard.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Friend, bless you for stopping to help me... But you're late, I'm afraid. My leg is broken. I can't stand...

But hear me... I chased the Bats down into the old cistern under the orchard...

But the cistern is home to something far worse -- swarms of Wisps! I saw them over the water, obeying a man's voice.

He was laughing... Drive them out, friend, and my purse is yours.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Did you get rid of the Wisps?

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
Ah, there you are! Healer Mossa says I'll walk again! Good work! Never thought you'd come up out of there! heh, heh, heh.

But here now, take your 100 gold and hurry on to the Star Tower where that wicked Vaskar hides!

journal.text:
Drive the Wisps from the cistern in order to help Fennick.

The way in is most likely through the old orchard well.

variants.specifics: Fort Vestrin: Ottmar the stablemaster wants the White Wolves cleared out of the ice cave above the stables.

offer.speaker: Ottmar
offer.text:
Impressive, the way you cut through those skeletons at the gate!

Now for the wolves. I've staked out a goat by the old ice cave above the stables, but the White Wolves won't come out while anybody stands close by.

Wait for me to bar the stable doors and then you go up after them. My old bow is yours if you do.

reminder.speaker: Ottmar
reminder.text: That old bow of mine is a fine weapon and will even drop a White Wolf before it gets close enough to bite.

completion.speaker: Ottmar
completion.text: Great! There is not one wolf left in that cave. Take this bow and I will let the mules out to graze again.

journal.text: Find the den of the White Wolves and clear it out.

variants.specifics: Ostrak: Yorga, who keeps the cooling pools, wants the Bats cleared from their roost up the slag road, and pays in her sister Quilla's potions.

offer.speaker: Yorga
offer.text:
So you're the one Gavrik sent! Wonderful! The Bats roost up the slag road to your left, in the big cave past the cooling pools. I've opened the Slag Gate for you. I'll make it worth your while.

Welcome to Ostrak!

completion.speaker: Yorga
completion.text: Ah, here they are... some of the finest potions in Ostrak. My sister Quilla mixed them for the stokers, in case the furnaces ever blew. They should serve you well against the fires you'll surely meet up on Mount Krell.

variants.specifics: Tarrow Crossing: Ottmar, a stubborn pig farmer, loses his pigs to the Bears of Thistle Wood.

offer.speaker: Ottmar
offer.text: No matter if the Bears carry off every last pig! This farm is all I have. Even a Grizzly wouldn't dare trespass on the land of an honest man! But if you clear out their den in Thistle Wood, I'll reward you well.

reminder.speaker: Ottmar
reminder.text: Thanks for stopping by. Now go get those Bears.

completion.speaker: Ottmar
completion.text: Thank you for killing those Bears. Here, take this shield.

journal.text: Locate the Bear den in Thistle Wood.

variants.specifics: Tullin: Barlo of the Tullin Watch boasts of beating the Ogres but pays the player to burn out a wasp nest in the old orchard.

offer.speaker: Barlo
offer.text:
Fear not, I have this whole business well in hand. I shall meet those Ogres wherever they dare to come down, it makes no difference to me.

But first there is a nest of wasps in the old orchard which none of my men will go near.

Once you burn it out, the Ogres shall learn the true might of the Tullin Watch! I'll pay you 80 gold for it.

reminder.speaker: Barlo
reminder.text: Hail, brave Adventurer! I am glad you have come back to me!

completion.speaker: Barlo
completion.text: Wasp stings will swell up something awful, but this potion will help with that. Here's your 80 gold.
